look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: On a flowering branch, inspect the five separate petals, numerous stamens, and oval toothed leaves; later check the small apple-like pomes with persistent calyx. Verify flowers and fruit together when possible, because ornamental Malus cultivars and other crabapples can look similar. This first photo shows open flowers, leaves, and buds, not ripe fruit.
diagnostic_image_needs: Mature fruit showing calyx and pedicel
Comparison with Malus coronaria and ornamental crabapple cultivars; verify taxon first
lookalike_note: Other Malus species and ornamental cultivars can resemble prairie crabapple. Confirm mature fruit, leaves, calyx and growth habit rather than assigning a species from pink-white flowers alone.
photo_note: One species-labeled Wikimedia Commons photograph of flowers and leaves, Krzysztof Ziarnek (Kenraiz), CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserve ShareAlike on adaptations. Physical image must be installed and validated by GitHub curation before claiming learner-ready.
